rules.passage-outcome: Overlapping literal operands and their dynamic path/message operation share admission and disposition.
rules.inherited-outcome: Joined Step 3/4 slots keep their disposition unless an explicit pinned evidence-backed override exists.
rules.pinned-passage: Every currentPassage exists at its exact line range in the pinned file, including relocation parks.
rules.dynamic-operand: Every admitted dynamic operation constructs/carries an actual path or document operand, not neighbouring metadata or formatting.
rules.co-cut-grep: Every emitted patch pins complete literal/escaped test grep results and joins every match to record, cutover spec and receipt.
rules.retiring-retained: A preserve may not use a retained witness for a target under retiring docs/specs or docs/architect; provenance must be explicit.
rules.coverage: Every selected file, literal, original origin and dynamic tuple is admitted or rejected exactly once.
rules.source-pins: Whole-file bytes/mode/current pin are real; prior record hashes and protected pins stay equal.
rules.source-spans: Current reference spans/passage and dynamic context match full source; unresolved relocation parks.
rules.rejections: Rejection names its exact own passage/non-document operation and cannot carry an active patch.
rules.parks: Every parked reference/tuple has its own blocker and dependency; no execution-ready park.
rules.patches: One complete deterministic applicable diff per current file; exact after hash and inverse rollback.
rules.targets: Pointer targets are current exact claim holders, not aliases or frozen generated-index rename copies.
rules.fixture-provenance: Every admitted synthetic fixture pins its constructor/owning test and proves its temporary target is not an alias.
rules.generated: Generated output bytes cannot receive authored diffs; owning source/generator must be joined.
rules.receipts: All required comparison fields/current/candidate/proofs/deltas/readiness and per-file joins exist.
rules.missing-proof: Missing/not-run proof cannot claim passing parity; passed proof has real log/hash and exit 0.
rules.gateway: Reuse pinned complete file equality; HTTP missing/error/content-type/fresh read is never inferred.
rules.setup: Parsed owner/path sets, scan-root deltas, sourceCaptureIds and inventory/export gaps explicit.
rules.message-deltas: Every admitted patch has exact current/candidate emitted expression and changelog prerequisite.
rules.review: Every file/reference/tuple/source byte appears in hash-bound parts <=60 records / 400000 bytes; no sample.
rules.a-passage-agreement: All pairs of overlapping operation intervals on the same line/passage agree in admission and effective disposition; independent adjacent expressions have distinct source intervals.
rules.b-real-blocker: R12: no boilerplate dependency shared after quoted operands, paths, IDs and line numbers are normalized; copies join their source passage; serialized state rows use their accepted per-file input dependency.
rules.c-render-owner: Every generated source-copy reference/tuple derives its disposition from the exact source owner; a park cites an actually parked source owner.
rules.d-own-operand: Each admitted dynamic tuple has its exact document-yielding sub-expression pathOperand in its pinned passage; every rejection names a closed R5 nonDocumentUse category.
rules.e-retired-successor: Preserved retired decision citations carry a live successorNote with a real heading anchor.
rules.r11-plans-boundary: R11: an operation rooted only in plans/** is rejected as plans-report-artifact; trace pinned declarations and imported constants, not adjacent context.
